data.title: 椎叶紬 · 甜点柜里的选择
data.description: 咖啡馆的点心柜里只剩两块蛋糕。紬在玻璃前来回看了好几次，最后指向带草莓的那一块。
data.action: pointing at a strawberry cake in a display case
data.promptProse: Standing in front of a curved glass pastry display case in a warm cafe, Tsumugi points with a cheerful smile at an ornate strawberry shortcake. Polished brass chandeliers illuminate rows of glazed tarts and pastries on the marble counter.
